import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input_data[0])
    m = int(input_data[1])
    if n > m:
        n, m = m, n

    V = n * m

    if V < 100:
        g = [[] for _ in range(V)]
        for i in range(V):
            for j in range(V):
                r1, c1 = divmod(i, m)
                r2, c2 = divmod(j, m)
                if abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2) == 3:
                    g[i].append(j)

        res = max_matching(g) * 2
        print(res)
    else:
        if n == 1:
            res = (m // 6) * 6
            if m % 6 == 4:
                res += 2
            elif m % 6 == 5:
                res += 4
        else:
            res = n * m
            res -= res % 2
        print(res)

def max_matching(graph):
    n = len(graph)
    match = [-1] * n
    p = [-1] * n
    for i in range(n):
        if match[i] == -1:
            v = find_path(graph, match, p, i)
            while v != -1:
                pv = p[v]
                ppv = match[pv]
                match[v] = pv
                match[pv] = v
                v = ppv
    return len([x for x in match if x != -1]) // 2

def find_path(graph, match, p, root):
    n = len(graph)
    base = list(range(n))
    used = [False] * n
    q = []
    used[root] = True
    q.append(root)
    while q:
        u = q.pop(0)
        for v in graph[u]:
            if base[u] == base[v] or match[u] == v:
                continue
            if v == root or (match[v] != -1 and p[match[v]] != -1):
                curbase = lca(match, base, p, u, v)
                blossom = [False] * n
                mark_path(match, base, blossom, p, u, curbase, v)
                mark_path(match, base, blossom, p, v, curbase, u)
                for i in range(n):
                    if blossom[base[i]]:
                        base[i] = curbase
                        if not used[i]:
                            used[i] = True
                            q.append(i)
            elif p[v] == -1:
                p[v] = u
                if match[v] == -1:
                    return v
                v2 = match[v]
                if not used[v2]:
                    used[v2] = True
                    q.append(v2)
    return -1

def mark_path(match, base, blossom, p, u, curbase, child):
    while base[u] != curbase:
        blossom[base[u]] = True
        blossom[base[match[u]]] = True
        p[u] = child
        u = p[match[u]]

def lca(match, base, p, a, b):
    used = [False] * len(match)
    while True:
        a = base[a]
        used[a] = True
        if match[a] == -1:
            break
        a = p[match[a]]
    while True:
        b = base[b]
        if used[b]:
            return b
        b = p[match[b]]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
